params.message:
The newsletter door and the team tools are reached again

The projection door answers everything under /internal/ it does not know with 401 or
404. The newsletter door and the team tools came after it and were never reached: a
newsletter sent by the site and a tool called through the Gentells MCP both got 401.
The projection door now comes last, and a test asks the doors through the real server.

The MCP tools also make the table their record goes in, as Ask's server does. Without
it a first change went through and then answered with an error.

Portal: Gentells-links opvragen vanuit een gekoppelde assistent werkt nu ook echt, en nieuwsbrieven op het leesadres komen weer binnen.
